zh-CN.title: 聊天背景可读性提升
items: 所有聊天背景统一使用清晰稳定的顶部栏与锁定区
群聊昵称增加轻量身份标签，在复杂背景上也能轻松辨认

en.title: Improved readability over chat backgrounds
items: All chat backgrounds now share clear, consistent header and pinned-message surfaces
Group-chat names use lightweight identity labels that remain readable over detailed artwork
